final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the claim more narrowly. That reinterpretation is partly valid: the record supports aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, a current subgroup regression, and a policy pathway in which disclosure or approved mitigation could support certification. That means clean compliance remains unsupported, and even the narrowed caveated-compliance theory remains conditional on evidence not in the record. The appropriate final posture is therefore still suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats, because the caveat is not merely explanatory; it is an unresolved compliance predicate.
